searchText: Does Nimbus' implementation of https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/?urls.primaryName=dev#/Validator/produceBlockV3 not support pre-Electra blocks? I see this error: > Failed to request block from beacon node: invalid ssz encoding. first variable element offset indexes into fixed value data This is running with Prysm VC which uses v3 exclusively All other clients (Prysm, Teku, Lodestar, Lighthouse) produce blocks without issues This error disappears after the Electra fork we'd probably not have tested it much, but does it work with JSON?
